scope: Post-evaluation operator diagnosis of the same frozen Luna initial firmware. Not a new candidate execution or retrospective RM review.

sequence: constructor sends panel commands including sleep-out/display-on
candidate calls panel reset, toggling LCD GPIO16 again
multiplex init skips panel command resend
confirmed_code_defects.finding: The panel is reset after configuration, without reconfiguration. Provided driver code and original ELF implement the physical reset, despite the manufacturer example comment saying RGB-only reset for multiplex mode.
confirmed_code_defects.causal_status: Strong explanation for black screen, based on executed init path, source/ELF trace and datasheet reset behavior. No corrected-firmware A/B test or panel register readback.

confirmed_code_defects.finding: Logical landscape 820x320 is also used as physical RGB h_res/v_res. Candidate assumes MADCTL D5=0x20 swaps axes; ST7701S MADCTL defines ML/BGR, not MV. Manufacturer uses physical 320x820 timing.
confirmed_code_defects.causal_status: Unsupported rotation assumption and manufacturer timing mismatch confirmed. Its independent optical effect is unmeasured because the post-configuration reset defect is also present.

runtime_observations.first_post_reset_capture: Sequence0 accepted in production receiver log; sequence1 write timed out. Exact diagnostic log does not use the generic CDM_RX marker, so capture.json acceptance fields remain null.
runtime_observations.second_post_reset_capture: Same-port reset,2s boot wait,1s wait per frame: host wrote both frames; no accepted/rejected frame logs. Not proof of either receipt.
runtime_observations.optical: User confirmed continued black screen after first diagnostic reset; no BOOT/30s/new image facts supplied.
